correctness.rationale: Exact Laplace integrals derive all two-mode coefficients. The normalized gain is the stated positive-denominator rational expression. Symbolic identities verify the factorization, discriminant 16W(W-3), and derivative. For 1<=W<3 the comparison quadratic is everywhere positive, for W=3 it factors into 4(t-5)^2, and for W>3 it is negative exactly on one interval where the derivative factor has exactly one root by convexity, giving the global maximizing carrier. The asymptotic follows from the shifted cubic. Independently integrated continuous half-line coefficients corroborate normalization, and the checker verifies exact identities.

value.rationale: Adaptive Laguerre tail representations must decide whether one carrier can economically cover two coherent oscillations. The lowest nontrivial two-mode case admits a rigorous four-optimizer coexistence at exactly omega/(2a)=sqrt(3), with a discontinuous optimal-carrier switch, and an explicit post-switch cubic branch. This is a natural complete constrained-approximation classification relevant to frequency detection; not arbitrary finite enumeration or a routine substitution. It does not claim unrestricted multi-carrier or noisy data benefits.
